C: A1 something that lives and moves but is not a human, bird, fish, or insect
（除人、鳥、魚和昆蟲之外的）動物；獸；牲畜
B2 anything that lives and moves, including people, birds, etc.
› informal an unpleasant, cruel person or someone who behaves badly
牲畜般的人；殘暴野蠻的人；豬狗不如的人
› used to describe what type of person or thing someone or something is

NONE: › made or obtained from an animal or animals
取自動物的；以動物為原料的
› relating to, or taking the form of, an animal or animals rather than a plant or human being
動物的

before noun: › [ before noun ] relating to physical desires or needs, and not spiritual or mental ones

example: wild/domestic animals
野生動物／家畜
Both children are real animal lovers.
兩個孩子都很喜愛動物。
Surveys show that animal welfare has recently become a major concern for many schoolchildren.
調查顯示動物福利近來已成為很多小學生關注的主要問題。
Humans, insects, reptiles, birds, and mammals are all animals.
人、昆蟲、爬行動物、鳥類和哺乳動物都是動物。
He's a real animal when he's had too much to drink.
他酒一喝多，簡直就是畜生。
At heart she is a political animal.
本質上她是一個很有政治秉性的人。
She is that rare animal (= she is very unusual), a brilliant scientist who can communicate her ideas to ordinary people.
她是個少見的奇才，是一位能夠把自己的思想傳達給普通人的優秀科學家。
Feminism in France and England are rather different animals (= are different).
法國和英國的女權主義不屬於同一種類型。
The island was devoid of all animal life (= there were no animals on the island).
這個島上沒有任何動物生存。
As an actor, he has a sort of animal magnetism.
作為一名演員，他具有一種對異性的吸引力。
She knew that Dave wasn't the right man for her but she couldn't deny the animal attraction between them.
她明知戴夫不是適合她的男人，但無法抗拒他們之間肉體上的吸引力。

NONE: › the farming of animals to produce foods such as meat, eggs, and milk
畜牧業
› animals as one of the groups that all natural things can be divided into
動物界

example: Chimpanzees are one of the closest human relatives in the animal kingdom.

More examplesThe whale has the largest brain in the animal kingdom.Lepidoptera is the scientific order of the animal kingdom that includes moths and butterflies.Stick bugs have some of the animal kingdom's cleverest camouflage.It would appear that parental love exists throughout the animal kingdom.

NONE: › the rights of animals to be treated well, for example by not being used for testing drugs or by not being hunted
動物權益（動物不被用於藥物試驗或不遭獵殺的權利）

example: She campaigns for animal rights.
她為動物權益而奔波。
Animal rights activists protested outside the laboratory.
保護動物權益的積極分子在實驗室外面抗議。

NONE: › having life
有生命的，活的
› to make someone seem more happy or active
使生氣勃勃；使有活力

example: A sparkle in his eyes animated his face whenever he smiled.
他一笑起來，眼睛就亮晶晶的，一時臉上也增添了生氣。

NONE: C2 full of interest and energy
活躍的；生氣勃勃的
› Animated films, drawings, models, etc. are ones that are photographed or created by a computer and shown in a way that makes them move.
（電影等）動畫製作的，動畫的；（木偶、模型等）能活動的；（繪畫）栩栩如生的

example: There was an extremely animated discussion on the subject.
這個話題引起了極其熱烈的討論。
They must have been having an interesting conversation - they both looked very animated.
他們一定是在進行甚麼有趣的談話，兩人看上去都興致勃勃的。

C or U: › [ C or U ] moving images created from drawings, models, etc. that are photographed or created by a computer

example: She spoke with great animation about her latest discoveries.
她興致盎然地談起了她最新的發現。
Encyclopedias on CD-ROM include sound, illustrations, and simple animations.
光碟電子百科全書裡有聲音、插圖和簡單的動畫。
Thanks to computer animation, it is now possible to make cartoons much more quickly than in the past.
有了電腦動畫製作技術，現在製作動畫片比過去快多了。

NONE: › someone who makes animated films, drawings, models, etc.
動畫片繪製者

example: Walt Disney is the most famous animator of feature-length films.
華特·迪士尼是最著名的可達到正片長度的動畫片繪製者。

NONE: › the use of machines controlled by computers to make puppets and models move in a natural way in films and other types of entertainment
電子動畫學；電子動畫技術；電腦動畫技術
› Japanese films made using characters and images that are drawn rather than real, or one of these films
（日本的）動畫片

example: Until recently, anime had little more than a cult following outside Japan.
以前，日本動畫片在日本以外的追隨者不多，這種情況最近發生了改變。
an anime that blurs the line between man and machine
一部模糊了人類和機器界限的日本動畫片

NONE: › the belief that all natural things, such as plants, animals, rocks, and thunder, have spirits and can influence human events
泛靈論，萬物有靈論
› strong dislike, opposition, or anger
仇恨；敵意；憎惡

example: Of course we're competitive, but there's no personal animosity between us.
我們固然是競爭對手，但我們之間並沒有私怨。
In spite of his injuries, he bears no animosity towards his attackers.
儘管受了傷，但他對襲擊他的人也沒有任何怨恨。
The European Community helped France and Germany forget the old animosities between them.
歐洲經濟共同體促使法國和德國摒棄前嫌。

NONE: › a feeling of hate or anger towards someone or something
仇視；惡意；敵意

example: He harbours no animus toward his rival.
他對競爭對手不懷任何敵意。

NONE: › an ion with a negative electrical charge
負離子，陰離子
› a Mediterranean plant with small, yellowish-white flowers and seeds that taste of liquorice, used to give this flavour to food and drink
茴芹
› the seeds of the anise plant, used to flavour sweet food and alcoholic drinks
茴芹籽，洋茴香
